title: fix(turning): part-off states the piece kept and a back stock
body:
Refreshed onto `main` after #3472 merged. The branch is no longer stacked.

## What changed

The Part (part-off) operation gets one setting, `kerf: PartKerf` (`crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs`). It has two values:

- `kept`: the piece that is the finished part.
  - `CutOff` (the default) is the #3452 rule. The whole kerf is on the chuck side.
  - `Chuck` keeps the piece in the chuck. The whole kerf is on the free-end side, and a stub comes off the free end.
- `back_stock` (mm, 0 or more, default 0): the whole kerf stands this far off the parting plane, into the scrap side. The part keeps that much on its end face for a later facing pass.

Where the setting is:

- Kernel: `part_in` reads the scrap side and the kerf flank from the setting.
- Gouge law: `part_kerf_refusal_for` judges the kerf against the part that `kept` names. It treats the back stock as part material. The old `part_kerf_refusal` calls it with the default.
- Ambiguous setup (`job.rs`, `generate.rs`): #3472's `part_off_problem` and `plane_inside_model` rule refuses the default (`CutOff`) where the model goes on past the plane on both sides and the setup cannot say which end is free. When the user sets `Chuck`, the setting states the side and the ambiguity refusal does not fire. The refusal message names the setting: "Or set 'The part is' to 'Chuck piece' to state the side."
- Project file: the keys `kept` (`cut_off` / `chuck`) and `back_stock` (`project/part_kerf_dto.rs`). Each key is written only when it is not the default.
- Page: the Passes tab of the Part op has "The part is" (Cut-off piece / Chuck piece) and "Back stock". Apply rides `EditOperationParams`.
- MCP: `edit_operation` patches `kept` and `back_stock` through `EditOperationParams`. No new tool is necessary.
- Validation: a negative or non-finite back stock is refused at the command door (`is_sane`), in the kernel and in the verdict.
- Stamp: the setting is folded only when it is not the default. A Part cache made by the old centred-kerf algorithm reads Stale through #3472's `part-off-kerf-side-v1` salt and does not post until the op is generated again.

The decision record: `docs/decisions/3469-part-kept-side.md`.

## Cause

#3472 put the whole kerf on the chuck side, and no parameter could change the side. In a flipped second setup the chuck holds the finished part. #3472 had to refuse every part-off there, which refuses a legal program (issue comments of 2026-11-22).

## Readings (3 mm GT-0300 blade, orientation 2: the -Z corner is posted)

| case | kerf | posted Z |
|---|---|---|
| #3452 pin, end face Z-70, default | Z-73..-70 | Z-73 (no change) |
| same, back stock 0.5 | Z-73.5..-70.5 | Z-73.5 |
| same, chuck piece | refused: "nothing to part ... stands wholly on the free-end side (higher Z) ... set 'The part is' to 'Cut-off piece'" | - |
| stubbed pin in the OP20 flip setup, plane Z-14, default | refused by name (names `Chuck piece`) | - |
| same, chuck piece | Z-14..-11 | Z-14 (the part's end face) |
| motion: part Z0..70 in the chuck, stub to Z84, plane Z70, chuck piece | Z70..73 | - |
| same, chuck piece, back stock 1 | Z71..74 | - |

## Tests

New pins. Each was red on the unchanged code (#3472 head 6c18258d1): the motion and app pins did not compile (no `PartKerf`, no `kerf` field), and the flip pin is refused there.

- `crates/motion/tests/turning_part_kept.rs` (new, 5 tests): the default #3452 case, the back stock, the chuck piece, the refusal with no model on the chuck side, and a back stock that is not a size.
- `crates/app/tests/lathe_part_off_kerf.rs`: the flipped-setup default refusal (now #3472's precise rule, and it names `Chuck piece`), the flipped setup with `Chuck` that posts Z-14, the back stock that posts Z-73.5, the chuck piece with nothing in the chuck, and the undoable edit that rides the project file.
- `crates/app/tests/mcp_part_kerf.rs` (new): `edit_operation_sets_the_kept_piece_and_back_stock_and_undo_restores_them`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/part_kerf_tests.rs` (new): `the_kept_piece_row_names_both_pieces_and_its_pick_applies_and_undoes`.
- `crates/app/tests/part_off_saved_before_3452.rs` (from #3472): opens a project recorded before #3452, asserts Stale and a refused post, then regenerates and posts.

Mechanical: each `OpParams::Part` and `PartParams` literal in the tests gets `kerf: Default::default()`.

### Mutation checks (each guard put back to the old code, then restored)

| mutation | result |
|---|---|
| kernel uses `chuck_side()` and the plane (ignores the setting) | RED: 3 tests of `turning_part_kept` |
| verdict ignores the back stock zone | RED: `a_back_stock_moves_the_whole_kerf_into_the_bar` |
| verdict uses `chuck_side()` (ignores `kept`) | RED: 2 chuck-piece tests |
| ambiguity refusal ignored for `Chuck` (the #3472 code) | RED: `a_flipped_setup_keeping_the_chuck_piece_cuts_the_stub_off_the_free_end` |
| no back stock check at the command door | RED: `the_kerf_setting_is_an_undoable_edit_and_rides_the_project_file` |

After the restore, all pins are green.

### Screenshots (the fork's images-only branch; no image is in this branch)

- Before: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/1829a04cef3bc212316daaee35dd78c5c8c8c57a/3503/2026-11-22/part-passes-before.png
- After: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/1829a04cef3bc212316daaee35dd78c5c8c8c57a/3503/2026-11-22/part-passes-after.png

### Gate

- `cargo check -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` was started on the refreshed tree. The motion build and `motion suites: lib` passed (573 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored, 204 s). The broad 714-step plan was stopped: a conflicts refresh runs the touched suites, not the whole plan.
- Pins on the pushed head `d9fd514b6142960a897b31c70806748dd5b1c28d`:
  - motion `turning_part_kept`: 5 passed.
  - motion `turning_part_kerf`: 6 passed.
  - app `lathe_part_off_kerf`: 9 passed.
  - app `mcp_part_kerf`: 1 passed.
  - app `part_off_saved_before_3452`: 2 passed.
  - app `setup_align_lathe`: 4 passed.
  - app `example_catalog` (full): 37 passed, 4 ignored.
  - ui `part_kerf_tests`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

### Heavy lanes

Not run. This is a `P3` PR (#3558). The cut gate runs the heavy lanes.

## Goldens moved

None. The merge of `main` brings #3472's corrected `cone-thread.nc` (`G01 X0. Z12. F0.02`) and its pin. The diff of this branch against `main` changes no `.nc`, `.cl` or catalog file.

## Not exercised

- A real control or machine. Lathe posts other than `fanuc-lathe.cps`.
- The UI in a live window (the page is tested through the kittest harness).

## Overlaps

- #3472 is merged, so this branch is no longer stacked.
- These open PRs touch the same files, but other functions or other kinds. None changes the Part variant, the Part page arm or the part-off law. Whichever merges second refreshes:
  - `operation/types/params.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `project/params_impl.rs`, `operation/kinds.rs`: #3494, #3441, #3439, #3426, #3402, #3391, #3387, #3353, #3283, #3251, #3103, #3058, #2890, #2831.
  - `operation/types/sane.rs`: #3426, #3402, #3283, #3251, #3058, #2831.
  - `operation/job.rs`, `operation/generate.rs`: #3458, #3283, #3251, #3115, #3059, #3058, and older ones.
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` (one `mod` line): many open UI PRs.

Effort: high (not escalated).

Changelog: Part (part-off) has a new setting. "The part is" chooses the cut-off piece (the default, as before) or the chuck piece, which cuts a stub off the free end of a part held end for end. "Back stock" moves the whole kerf that far off the parting plane, so the part keeps material on its end face for a later facing pass. The gouge check judges the kerf against the part that the setting keeps. Where a setup cannot say which end of the part is free, the default is refused and the refusal names the setting. An explicit chuck-piece setting states the side. Existing projects post the same program, and a pre-#3452 part-off cache is refused until it is generated again.

Fixes #3469
